name: Blossom and Spore Bracelets
body:
Aura moderate enchantment; Slot wrists; CL 13th; Weight —; Price 2,950 gp

DESCRIPTION

These thin gold and platinum bracelets are encrusted with small emeralds and are decorated with a plant motif.

When worn they keep the wearer smelling fresh and clean (removing any bonuses to track with the scent ability) and keeps them immune to extreme smells and any smell-based nausea or sickening effects also. In addition, once per week the bracers can flower and throw spores or plant pollen at a single target within 10 feet, as a standard action. Pollen causes a charm person effect, and spores cause a reduced control undead effect on any single Medium or Small sized mindless undead.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells charm person, control undead, neutralize poison, prestidigitation; Cost 1,475 gp
